Closed-issue acceptance audit, 2026-10-26
Audited against master e301be6, issue bodies, repository implementation/checks,
prior verification notes and explicit user confirmations. A solved sub-report is
not evidence that every criterion of its broader ticket is complete.

OTHER CAVE DETAILS
97 is already OPEN for separate stalagmite/bones/mushroom/puddle prop art and a
spawner. This batch's existing atlas overlay decals do not complete that issue.
wall_full_0..3 are alternate precomposed geometry, not missing decoration; the
active cap/face/corner assembly is used instead, so drawing both would double walls.

NEW RULE
List unmet acceptance criteria explicitly in completion reports. Keep/reopen the
broader issue even when a narrow fix is confirmed. Never call an unchecked box
incomplete solely because the issue body was not updated; inspect the actual code.
